gui.settings.title: Settings
gui.settings.calibrate_roll_instructions:
Calibrate Roll:
1. Set speed: Supercruise 50%
2. Target remote System
3. Maneuver target to 12 o'clock on compass.
gui.settings.calibrate_pitch_yaw_instruc:
Calibrate Pitch & Yaw:
1. Set speed: Supercruise 50%
2. Target remote System
3. Maneuver target to center of screen (and compass).
gui.settings.command_slf_attack_at_will: Command SLF to Attack At Will

gui.tooltips.fsd_route_assist:
Will execute your route. 
At each jump sequence will perform some fuel scooping.
gui.tooltips.supercruise_assist:
Will keep your ship pointed to target, 
you target can only be a station for autodocking to work.
gui.tooltips.waypoint_assist:
When selected, will prompt for waypoint file. 
The waypoint file contains System names that 
will be entered into Galaxy Map and route plotted.
gui.tooltips.dss_assist: When selected, will perform DSS scans while you are traveling between stars.
gui.tooltips.elw_scanner:
Will perform FSS scans while FSD Assist is traveling between stars. 
If FSS shows a signal in region of Earth, 
Water or Ammonia type worlds, it will announce that discovery.
gui.tooltips.afk_combat_assist: Used with a AFK Combat ship in a Rez Zone.
gui.tooltips.roll_rate: Roll rate your ship has in deg/sec. Higher is number more maneuverable ship.
gui.tooltips.pitch_rate: Pitch (up/down) rate your ship has in deg/sec. Higher is number more maneuverable ship.
gui.tooltips.yaw_rate: Yaw rate (rudder) your ship has in deg/sec. Higher is number more maneuverable ship.
gui.tooltips.sun_pitch_up_time:
This field are for ship that tend to overheat. 
Providing 1-2 more seconds of Pitch up when avoiding the Sun 
will overcome this problem.
gui.tooltips.sun_bright_threshold:
The low level for brightness detection, 
range 0-255, want to mask out darker items
gui.tooltips.nav_align_tries: How many attempts to ap should make at alignment.
gui.tooltips.jump_tries: How many attempts to ap should make to jump.
gui.tooltips.docking_retries: How many attempts to make to dock.
gui.tooltips.wait_for_autodock:
After docking granted, 
wait this amount of time for us to get docked with autodocking
gui.tooltips.start_fsd: Button to start FSD route assist.
gui.tooltips.refuel_threshold:
If fuel level get below this level, 
it will attempt refuel.
gui.tooltips.scoop_timeout:
Number of second to wait for full tank, 
might mean we are not scooping well or got a small scooper
gui.tooltips.fuel_threshold_abort:
Level at which AP will terminate, 
because we are not scooping well.
gui.tooltips.x_offset: Offset left screen to start place overlay text.
gui.tooltips.y_offset: Offset down screen to start place overlay text.
gui.tooltips.calibrate:
Will iterate through a set of scaling values 
getting best match for your system. 
See HOWTO-Calibrate.md
gui.tooltips.waypoint_list_button: Read in a file with with your Waypoints.
gui.tooltips.cap_mouse_xy:
This will provide the StationCoord value of Station in SystemMap. 
Selecting this button and then clicking on the Station in SystemMap 
will return x,y value that can be pasted in waypoints file
gui.tooltips.reset_waypoint_list:
Reset your waypoint list, 
the waypoint assist will start again at the first point in the list.
gui.tooltips.debug_overlay:
Enables debug data to be displayed over 
Elite Dangerous screen while playing the game.
gui.tooltips.debug_ocr: Enables OCR debug output to be stored in 'ocr_output' folder.
gui.tooltips.debug_images: Enables debug images to be stored in 'debug_output' folder.
gui.tooltips.modifier_key_delay: Delay for key modifiers to ensure modifier is detected before/after the key.
gui.tooltips.default_hold_time: Default hold time for a key press.
